name: Nyuu wa SHOCK!! ~Pai o Torimodose!~
source:
Kentarou inherited from his father "Bus-to Shinken", an ancient martial arts tenchnique that allows to change opponent's bust size by striking at certain body points. However, his flat-chested step-sister Rao has sworn to eliminate all boobs in the world using this technique. Obviously, Kentarou can't permit such travesty to materialize, so the fateful showdown is about to ensue!

A Hokuto no Ken/Fist of the North Star parody eroge.
translation:
薄霭拳太郎从父亲那里继承了古代武术“爆乳神拳”。只要击中对手身上的特定穴位，这门武术就能随意改变对方乳房的大小。然而，他那胸部平坦的继妹薄霭罗央却立誓运用同一种武术，消灭世上所有乳房。拳太郎当然不能容许如此荒唐的事情成为现实，一场宿命对决即将打响！

这是一部恶搞《北斗神拳》的成人游戏。
